title.zh: 将莱特省 Palompon 市镇 Central II 描笼涯的 Tinabilan 国立中学附属校分离，改设为独立的 Palompon 国立中学，并为此拨款
title.en: An Act Separating the Tinabilan National High School - Palompon Annex in Barangay Central II, Municipality of Palompon, Province of Leyte From the Tinabilan National High School, Converting It Into An Independent National High School to Be Known as Palompon National High School and Appropriating Funds Therefor
title.orig: An Act Separating the Tinabilan National High School - Palompon Annex in Barangay Central II, Municipality of Palompon, Province of Leyte From the Tinabilan National High School, Converting It Into An Independent National High School to Be Known as Palompon National High School and Appropriating Funds Therefor
title.vi: Đạo luật tách Phân hiệu Palompon của Trường Trung học Tinabilan Quốc gia tại Barangay Central II, Đô thị Palompon, Tỉnh Leyte khỏi Trường Trung học Tinabilan Quốc gia và chuyển thành Trường Trung học Độc lập Quốc gia với tên gọi Trường Trung học Palompon Quốc gia, và bố trí kinh phí
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติแยกวิทยาเขต Palompon ของโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษา Tinabilan แห่งชาติในบารังไกย์ Central II เทศบาล Palompon จังหวัด Leyte ออกจากโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษา Tinabilan แห่งชาติและยกฐานะเป็นโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษาเอกเทศแห่งชาติชื่อโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษา Palompon แห่งชาติ และจัดสรรงบประมาณ
title.id: Undang-Undang Memisahkan Kampus Palompon, Sekolah Menengah Tinabilan Nasional di Barangay Central II, Kotamadya Palompon, Provinsi Leyte dari Sekolah Menengah Tinabilan Nasional dan menjadi Sekolah Menengah Mandiri Nasional dengan nama Sekolah Menengah Palompon Nasional, dan mengalokasikan dana
title.ms: Akta Memisahkan Kampus Palompon, Sekolah Menengah Tinabilan Kebangsaan di Barangay Central II, Perbandaran Palompon, Wilayah Leyte daripada Sekolah Menengah Tinabilan Kebangsaan dan menjadi Sekolah Menengah Bebas Kebangsaan dengan nama Sekolah Menengah Palompon Kebangsaan, dan memperuntukkan dana

text.en: Separation and Conversion into a National High School. – The Tinabilan National High School – Palompon Annex in Barangay Central II, Municipality of Palompon, Province of Leyte is hereby separated from the Tinabilan National High School and converted into an independent national high school to be known as Palompon National High School.

Transfer of Assets and Liabilities. – All personnel, assets, liabilities and records of the Tinabilan National High School – Palompon Annex are hereby transferred to and absorbed by the Palompon National High School.

Appropriations. – The Secretary of Education shall immediately include in the Department’s program the operationalization of the Palompon National High School, the initial funding of which shall be charged against the current year’s appropriations of the Tinabilan National High School – Palompon Annex. Thereafter, the amount necessary for the continued operation of the school shall be included in the annual General Appropriations Act.
Implementation. – The Secretary of Education shall issue such rules and regulations as may be necessary to carry out the purpose of this Act.
Effectivity. – This Act shall take effect fifteen (15) days after its publication in the Official Gazette.
